name: read_presentation
description:
Read a JSON representation of a Google Slides presentation.

Corresponds to [`presentations.get`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/slides/api/reference/rest/v1/presentations/get) in the REST API.

commentsIncluded.description: Optional. If true, comments will be included in the response. By default, comments are not included.

fields.description: Optional. A field mask specifying which subset of properties to return. Paths MUST accurately match the Google Slides REST API JSON resource structure (e.g. Presentation, Page, PageElement, Shape, Image, Table, Line, Video, TextContent). IMPORTANT GUIDELINES: - Always use targeted field masks rather than fetching unmasked or generic full presentation objects. - Syntax: Supports dot notation and subselection parentheses (e.g. `slides.pageElements(objectId,shape.text)` or `slides.pageElements.objectId,slides.pageElements.shape.text`). - Only include the fields you need.

presentationId.description: Required. The ID of the presentation to read content from.

name: read_slide_page
description:
Read a JSON representation of a single slide/page from a Google Slides presentation.

Corresponds to [`presentations.pages.get`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/slides/api/reference/rest/v1/presentations.pages/get) in the REST API.

inputSchema.description: Request to read a single presentation page.

commentsIncluded.description: Optional. If true, comments will be included in the response. By default, comments are not included.

fields.description: Optional. A field mask specifying which subset of properties to return for the slide page. Paths MUST accurately match the Google Slides REST API resource structure (e.g. Page, PageElement, Shape, Image, Table, Line, Video, TextContent). IMPORTANT GUIDELINES: - Always use targeted field masks rather than fetching unmasked or generic full page objects. - Syntax: Supports dot notation and subselection parentheses (e.g. `pageElements(objectId,shape.text)` or `pageElements.objectId,pageElements.shape.text`). - Only include the fields you need.

pageId.description: Required. The ID of the slide page to retrieve.

presentationId.description: Required. The ID of the presentation containing the page.

name: read_slide_page_thumbnail
description:
Reads a thumbnail representation of a single slide page in a presentation, returning the thumbnail image URL along with its width and height dimensions.

Corresponds to [`presentations.pages.getThumbnail`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/slides/api/reference/rest/v1/presentations.pages/getThumbnail) in the REST API.

ThumbnailProperties.description: Provides control over page thumbnail creation.

mimeType.description: Optional. The optional mime type of the thumbnail image. If a mime type is not specified, the default mime type is PNG.

thumbnailSize.description: Optional. The optional thumbnail image size. If a thumbnail size is not specified, the server chooses a default size of the image.
x-google-enum-descriptions: The default thumbnail image size. The unspecified thumbnail size implies that the server chooses the size of the image in a way that might vary in the future.

inputSchema.description: Request to read a thumbnail representation of a single slide page in a presentation.

pageId.description: Required. The ID of the slide page to retrieve a thumbnail for.

presentationId.description: Required. The ID of the presentation containing the page to retrieve a thumbnail for.

thumbnailProperties.description: Optional. The optional properties of the thumbnail image to be returned.

name: update_presentation
description:
Updates a presentation with set of batchUpdate requests.

Corresponds to [`presentations.batchUpdate`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/slides/api/reference/rest/v1/presentations/batchUpdate) in the REST API.

The list of possible updates is:

- `createSlide`: Creates a new slide.
  Schema:
    - `objectId` (string, optional): A user-supplied object ID. Must be unique if specified (5-50 characters, matching [a-zA-Z0-9_-:]). If omitted, an ID is generated.
    - `insertionIndex` (integer, optional): Zero-based index indicating where to insert the slide. If omitted, inserted at the end.
    - `slideLayoutReference` (object, optional): Layout reference of the slide to insert (exactly one required if specified):
      - `predefinedLayout` (string): Predefined layout name (e.g. "BLANK", "TITLE_AND_BODY", "TITLE", "SECTION_HEADER", "SECTION_TITLE_AND_DESCRIPTION", "ONE_COLUMN_TEXT", "MAIN_POINT", "BIG_NUMBER", "TITLE_AND_TWO_COLUMNS").
      - `layoutId` (string): Layout ID from the current master.
    - `placeholderIdMappings` (array of objects, optional): Mappings for placeholders from layout to slide. Each item:
      - `layoutPlaceholder` (object): `{"type": string, "index": integer}`.
      - `objectId` (string, required): User-supplied object ID for the placeholder element.
- `createShape`: Creates a new shape.
  Schema:
    - `objectId` (string, optional): A user-supplied object ID. If omitted, an ID is generated.
    - `elementProperties` (object, required): Element location and sizing:
      - `pageObjectId` (string, required): Object ID of the page where the shape is located.
      - `size` (object, optional): `{"width": {"magnitude": number, "unit": string}, "height": {"magnitude": number, "unit": string}}` (unit: "PT" or "EMU").
      - `transform` (object, optional): AffineTransform `{"scaleX": number, "scaleY": number, "shearX": number, "shearY": number, "translateX": number, "translateY": number, "unit": string}`.
    - `shapeType` (string, required): Type of shape (e.g. "RECTANGLE", "ROUND_RECTANGLE", "ELLIPSE", "TEXT_BOX", "LINE", etc.).
- `createTable`: Creates a new table.
  Schema:
    - `objectId` (string, optional): A user-supplied object ID. If omitted, an ID is generated.
    - `elementProperties` (object, required): Element location and sizing:
      - `pageObjectId` (string, required): Object ID of the page where the table is located.
      - `size` (object, optional): `{"width": {"magnitude": number, "unit": string}, "height": {"magnitude": number, "unit": string}}`.
      - `transform` (object, optional): AffineTransform `{"scaleX": number, "scaleY": number, "shearX": number, "shearY": number, "translateX": number, "translateY": number, "unit": string}`.
    - `rows` (integer, required): Number of rows in the table.
    - `columns` (integer, required): Number of columns in the table.
- `insertText`: Inserts text into a shape or table cell.
  Schema:
    - `objectId` (string, required): Object ID of the shape or table.
    - `cellLocation` (object, optional): Table cell if inserting into table: `{"rowIndex": integer, "columnIndex": integer}`.
    - `text` (string, required): Text to insert.
    - `insertionIndex` (integer, optional): Zero-based character index where text will be inserted. Defaults to 0.
- `insertTableRows`: Inserts rows into a table.
  Schema:
    - `tableObjectId` (string, required): Object ID of the table.
    - `cellLocation` (object, required): Reference cell location: `{"rowIndex": integer, "columnIndex": integer}`.
    - `insertBelow` (boolean, required): Whether to insert new rows below the reference cell.
    - `number` (integer, required): Number of rows to insert (maximum 20).
- `insertTableColumns`: Inserts columns into a table.
  Schema:
    - `tableObjectId` (string, required): Object ID of the table.
    - `cellLocation` (object, required): Reference cell location: `{"rowIndex": integer, "columnIndex": integer}`.
    - `insertRight` (boolean, required): Whether to insert new columns to the right of the reference cell.
    - `number` (integer, required): Number of… [truncated]

WriteControl.description: Provides control over how write requests are executed.

requiredRevisionId.description: The revision ID of the presentation required for the write request. If specified and the required revision ID doesn't match the presentation's current revision ID, the request is not processed and returns a 400 bad request error.

presentationId.description: Required. The ID of the presentation to update.

requests.description: Required. A list of batchUpdate requests, using the schema and semantics documented at https://developers.google.com/workspace/slides/api/reference/rest/v1/presentations/request

name: read_file_content
description:
Call this tool to fetch a natural language representation of a known Drive file, and if specified, its comments.

REQUIREMENTS & WORKFLOW:
 - `fileId` is required. You MUST pass an exact Drive file ID returned by a previous discovery tool (`search_files` or `list_recent_files`) or provided explicitly in the user prompt.
 - NEVER guess, invent, or hallucinate a `fileId` string from a file title or name.
 - If given a file title, name, or topic without an explicit `fileId`, you MUST FIRST call `search_files` to find the file and retrieve its `fileId` before invoking this tool.

The file content may be incomplete for very large files. The text representation will change over time, so don't make assumptions about the particular format of the text returned by this tool. If supported and specified, comment tags will be included in the content.

Supported Mime Types:

 - `application/vnd.google-apps.document` (supports comments)
 - `application/vnd.google-apps.presentation` (supports comments)
 - `application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet` (supports comments)
 - `application/pdf` 
 - `application/msword` 
 - `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document` 
 - `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet` 
 - `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation` 
 - `application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet` 
 - `application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.presentation` 
 - `application/x-vnd.oasis.opendocument.text` 
 - `image/png` 
 - `image/jpeg` 
 - `image/jpg` 

If the file is not found, try using other tools like `search_files` to find the file the user is requesting using keywords.

inputSchema.description: Request to read file content with support for fetching comments.

fileId.description: Required. The ID of the file to retrieve.

includeComments.description: Whether to include comments in the response. Comments will be inlined in the text content of the file with a mapping to the comment threads. Note: Comments are only supported for Google Docs, Slides, and Sheets.

name: get_file_metadata
description:
Call this tool to find general metadata about a user's Drive file.

Context window token management can be tuned via `snippetVerbosity` (default is `SnippetVerbosity.DETAILED`) or if only metadata is needed, use `excludeContentSnippets`.

If the file is not found, try using other tools like `search_files` to find the file the user is requesting.

excludeContentSnippets.description: If true, the content snippet will be excluded from the response.

fileId.description: Required. The ID of the file to retrieve.

snippetVerbosity.description: Optional. Set to specify how verbose the snippets should be. Defaults to DETAILED if not set.
x-google-enum-descriptions: Limits the returned snippet to about 1000 characters.
Limits the returned snippet to about 2500 characters.
Limits the returned snippet to about 5000 characters.
The verbosity is greatly increased, limited by the overall response size.

name: copy_file
description:
Call this tool to copy an existing File in Google Drive.
The tool allows specifying a new title and a parent folder for the copy.
If the title is not specified, the copy title will be 'Copy of {original title}'.
If the parent folder is not specified, the copy will be created in the same folder as the original file, unless the requesting user does not have write access to that folder, in which case the copy will be created in the user's root folder.Returns the newly created File object upon successful copying.

fileId.description: Required. The ID of the file to copy.

parentId.description: The parent id of the newly created file. If empty, the file will be created with the same parent as the original file.

title.description: The title of the newly created file. If empty, the title will be 'Copy of {original file title}'.

name: create_file
description:
Call this tool to create or upload a File to Google Drive.

If uploading content, prefer `textContent` for text content. For non-UTF8 contents, use the `base64Content` field and base64 encode the data to set on that field.

Returns a single File object upon successful creation.

The following Google first-party mime types can be created without providing content:

 - `application/vnd.google-apps.document` 
 - `application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet` 
 - `application/vnd.google-apps.presentation` 

Folders can be created by setting the mime type to `application/vnd.google-apps.folder`.

When uploading content, the `contentMimeType` field is required and should match the type of the content being uploaded.

By default, supported content will be converted to Google first-party mime types.

To disable conversions for first-party mime types, set `disableConversionToGoogleType` to true.

base64Content.description: Optional. The base64 encoded content to upload. It's an error to set this and `textContent`.

content.description: Deprecated: Use `base64Content` or `textContent` instead. The content of the file encoded as base64. The content field should always be base64 encoded regardless of the mime type of the file.

contentMimeType.description: The mime type of the content being uploaded. Required when any type of content is provided.

disableConversionToGoogleType.description: Set to true to retain the passed in content mime type and not convert to a Google type. For example, without this a `text/plain` content mime type will be converted to to `application/vnd.google-apps.document`. Has no effect for types that do not have a Google equivalent.

inheritedPermissionsDisabled.description: Set to true to disable inherited permissions on the created folder, restricting access to only users with direct permissions on the folder.

mimeType.description: Deprecated: DO NOT USE!! Set `contentMimeType` instead.

parentId.description: The parent id of the file.

textContent.description: Optional. The (UTF-8) text content to upload. It's an error to set this and `base64Content`.

title.description: Required. The title of the file.
